messages:
Ava: Heads-up — Jordan from Acme is stopping by at 2pm for a quick product tour. Please badge them in and seat them near conf B if possible. Also, a courier (UPS) said 3 small parcels for "Acme - Jordan" will arrive ~1:45. Thanks! @Front Desk Bot please confirm. :wave:

Front Desk Bot: Visitor pre-registration found. Jordan (jordan@acme.com) — check-in code 7621. Badge will be printed on arrival. Parcel note added to today's deliveries list.

Miguel: Can we free up the two-seat hotdesk next to conf B? I have a call at 3 but can move. :+1:

Samir: I put a sticky on my desk — happy to move chairs around. Also Jordan mentioned carrying a guitar case, fyi (might need extra space in lobby).

Priya: Parcel locker is full at 1. We can keep small packages at reception. If anything larger, please ping me and I'll move to storage.

Jules: @Ava — do we have a guest Wi‑Fi QR or should front desk hand out creds?

Front Desk Bot: Guest WiFi QR laminated at reception. Default pass: RedwoodGuest2025 (exp 24h). Will hand QR + badge.

Deliveries Bot: UPS delivered 3 packages at 13:49 — labels: Acme/Jordan — package IDs U1234, U1235, U1236. Status: Held at front desk.

Ava: Thanks all. @Miguel appreciate the swap. @Samir pls leave one chair. @Priya if any of U1234-6 are oversized, tag me and I'll escort Jordan. :thumbsup:

Miguel: Moving now. chair → conf B hotdesk.

Samir: Done. Left one chair.

Priya: I've moved one medium parcel to storage shelf B2 (U1236). Others at reception.

Ava: Perfect. I'll be there for the 2pm check-in.
